profile.name: Newport 2832-C双通道光功率计
profile.description: Newport 2832-C是一款台式双通道光功率计，用于读取光功率探头或相关探测器通道的测量值。设备支持按波长进行校准设置，并提供外部触发、数据采集与缓冲存储等功能，适合光学实验中进行连续功率监测与记录。
profile.description_en: The Newport 2832-C is a benchtop dual-channel optical power meter used to read measurements from optical power sensor heads or related detector channels. It supports wavelength-based calibration settings and provides external triggering, data acquisition, and buffered data storage for continuous optical power monitoring and logging in laboratory experiments.
